item.title: SCHIZO Release Full Live Video from Obscene Extreme Festival 2025
item.description: The full official video of SCHIZO‘s devastating concert at the Obscene Extreme Festival in Trutnov, Czech Republic, on 12 July 2025 is available now. Watch below. item.title: HELIX to Release New Album “Scrap Metal” on January 23rd, Feat. Five Unreleased Tracks
item.description: Perris Records announces the release of HELIX’s new full length album “SCRAP METAL” on January 23rd, 2026. The digital singles release dates are December 12th, 2025 for “Stuck In The 80’s” and December 19th, 2025 for “Fast & Furious”. This will be the 14th Helix release on Perris Records. item.title: MAWIZA Release Live Session with Gojira’s Joe Duplantier
item.description: While already Chilean Grammy winners, this year, Mawiza continued their rise as a guiding force for indigenous metal. Behind their critically-acclaimed new album ÜL, the modern day Mapuche warriors appeared on magazine covers, took the stage at major summer festivals and brought home a LIT Music Award. item.title: SYBERIA Announce New Album “Quan tot s’apagui” + Premiere Haunting First Track & Video ‘llampecs d’oblit d’uns records en vida’
item.description: Following the release of their critically acclaimed 2022 full-length “Statement On Death” on Metal Blade Records, Barcelona’s instrumental post-metal quartet SYBERIA returns with their new album “Quan tot s’apagui”, set for release on January 30, 2026 via Moment of Collapse Records. item.title: FIFTEEN STITCHES Release New Music Video for ‘Nemo Liber’
item.description: Hard rock force Fifteen Stitches is back with the brand-new music video for “Nemo Liber” (No One Is Free). item.title: AS THE SUN FALLS Announce New Full-Length Album “Songs From The Veil”, Out in 2026
item.description: AS THE SUN FALLS announces their next full-length album, “Songs From The Veil“, set for release in 2026 via Theogonia Records.
